mcqs.question: A particle moves in a circle of radius 2 m. At time t₁ its angular position is 30°, and at time t₂ it is 90°. Which statement correctly describes angular position?

options.A: It is measured in meters along the circumference.
options.B: It is the same as the linear distance travelled along the path.
options.C: It is the angle swept from a fixed reference line, expressed in degrees or radians.
options.D: It remains constant if the particle’s speed is constant.

mcqs.answer: It is the angle swept from a fixed reference line, expressed in degrees or radians.
mcqs.explanation: Angular position specifies the orientation of a point on a circle relative to a chosen reference direction and is measured in angular units (degrees or radians). It is not a linear distance, nor does it stay constant when the particle moves, even at constant speed. Option C correctly defines angular position.

mcqs.question: A car travels at constant speed around a circular track. Why does the car experience a centripetal acceleration?

options.A: Because its speed is continuously increasing.
options.B: Because the direction of its velocity changes continuously toward the centre of the circle.
options.C: Because a net outward (centrifugal) force acts on it.
options.D: Because its mass is decreasing while it moves.

mcqs.answer: Because the direction of its velocity changes continuously toward the centre of the circle.
mcqs.explanation: Centripetal acceleration arises from the continual change in the direction of the velocity vector, which points toward the centre of the circular path. It does not require a change in speed, nor does an outward force cause it. Option B captures the correct reasoning.

mcqs.question: Particle A moves in a circle of radius 1 m and particle B moves in a circle of radius 3 m. Both have the same angular speed ω. Which statement correctly compares their linear speeds?
mcqs.explanation: Linear speed v = r ω. With the same ω, v_A = 1 ω and v_B = 3 ω, so v_A is one‑third of v_B. Option C expresses this relationship correctly.

mcqs.question: A stone of mass 0.5 kg is whirled in a horizontal circle of radius 0.8 m with a speed of 12 m s⁻¹. What is the magnitude of its centripetal acceleration?
mcqs.explanation: Centripetal acceleration a_c = v²/r = (12)² / 0.8 = 144 / 0.8 = 180 m s⁻². Option A is the correct value.

mcqs.question: Which of the following best defines uniform circular motion?

options.A: Motion in a circle with constant speed.
options.B: Motion in a circle with constant angular acceleration.
options.C: Motion along any curved path with varying speed.
options.D: Motion in a straight line with constant speed.

mcqs.answer: Motion in a circle with constant speed.
mcqs.explanation: Uniform circular motion means the object travels along a circular path while its speed (magnitude of velocity) remains constant; only the direction changes. Option A captures this definition precisely.

mcqs.question: If a point on a rotating disc moves from the 12 o’clock position to the 3 o’clock position, its angular displacement is:
mcqs.explanation: Moving from the top (12 o’clock) to the right (3 o’clock) sweeps a quarter of a full circle, which equals 90°. Option A is correct.

mcqs.question: Centripetal acceleration differs from tangential acceleration because it is:

options.A: Directed along the tangent to the path.
options.B: Responsible for a change in the speed of the object.
options.C: Directed towards the centre of the circular path.

mcqs.answer: Directed towards the centre of the circular path.
mcqs.explanation: Centripetal acceleration always points radially inward, toward the centre of the circle, whereas tangential acceleration points along the tangent and changes the speed. Option C correctly distinguishes the two.

mcqs.question: A wheel of radius 0.5 m rotates at 120 revolutions per minute (rpm). What is the linear speed of a point on its rim?
mcqs.explanation: First convert rpm to rad s⁻¹: 120 rpm = 2 rev s⁻¹ = 2 × 2π rad s⁻¹ = 4π rad s⁻¹. Linear speed v = r ω = 0.5 m × 4π rad s⁻¹ = 2π m s⁻¹ ≈ 6.28 m s⁻¹. Option B matches this value.
